text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired: inference_kv_cache_miss_rate > 12% (service: runtime-serving-prod)
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident #PD-4921 triggered, escalation policy: runtime-oncall.
jamie: acked. i'll take a look — putting my headphones on.
jamie: quick glance at dashboards — small burst across a subset of hosts in us-west-2, kv miss rate spike, p50 latency up ~180ms. not global.
jamie: running `kubectl get pods -n runtime -l app=kv-cache -o wide` to see pod churn
jamie:```
NAME                                     READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
kv-cache-3b7c      2/2     Running   0          5d
kv-cache-6ff1      2/2     Running   0          6d
kv-cache-9d2a      1/2     CrashLoop 4          3h
```
jamie: seeing a crashloop on one replica; could explain localized miss spike. checking logs
jamie: `kubectl logs kv-cache-9d2a -n runtime --previous` shows OOM killer in container: `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError` in cache-indexer thread
sara: @jamie nice catch. is it an oom after recent rollout?
jamie: there's a canary RC from 2h ago with a slightly higher heap setting, but this pod looks like it lost memory (smaller instance). maybe scheduler put it on a smaller node. scaling policy should prevent this tho.
sara: can you try moving the pod? `kubectl delete pod kv-cache-9d2a -n runtime` will reschedule.
jamie: deleting now.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by jamie.
jamie: pod rescheduled to kv-cache-cc34 on a larger instance, logs warmup looks normal. miss rate already trending down.
incident-bot: ALERT auto-resolved: inference_kv_cache_miss_rate (value dropped below threshold).
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident #PD-4921 auto-resolved (no manual acknowledge needed).
sara: thanks. sounds like noisy single-pod OOM + scheduling oddity. not customer impacting but could be noisy.
jamie: agree — impact was limited to a small shard, most requests stayed on healthy replicas.
jamie: follow-ups: 1) infra: add node-affinity/check to avoid small nodes for kv-cache; 2) alerting: add short suppression window for single-host spikes so we don't page on 1/30 hosts; 3) ops: add heap-growth check to rollout job.
oliver: i'll pick up infra changes tomorrow in the infra backlog.
sara: i'll open a ticket for alert tuning and link to logs. thanks @jamie for quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
jamie: no customer impact, marking as "no-pager followup" in the PD note and handing off to oliver for infra.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed.
